get_photo.description: Fetch one particular photo from the catalogue by its id, at whatever size you need. Use it once you have found a photo you like: store its id, and every run brings back that exact photo. Browse photos lists the ids. No account or API key required.

description: Real photographs to stand in for the ones you do not have yet. Ask Lorem Picsum for a size and it hands back a photo from Unsplash at that size: the placeholder for a mock-up, a demo email, a seeded test database or a design draft. Take one at random, take the same one every time for a given customer or product, build a whole catalogue of them in one step, or browse the library and keep the ids you like. Any size up to 5000 pixels, in colour or black and white, sharp or blurred, as a link or as a file to attach. No account or API key required.
